meta.title: Business systems & databases
meta.description: Connect operations, workflows, and data with custom business software from AJS Technologies.

title: Less scattered work.
intro: Bring the information your team needs into systems that reflect how your business actually works.
overviewText: When tools and spreadsheets no longer fit, we help map your processes and build a practical system around your people, data, and decisions.

deliverables.title: Operations software
deliverables.text: Manage inventory, projects, customers, or internal processes in a focused workspace.

deliverables.title: Databases & migration
deliverables.text: Plan data structures, clean up information, and move toward a dependable foundation.

deliverables.title: Reporting dashboards
deliverables.text: Turn agreed business metrics into useful, understandable views.

deliverables.title: Workflow integration
deliverables.text: Connect existing tools and reduce unnecessary manual handoffs.

outcomes: Bring important information into one view
Reduce repeated entry and disconnected processes
Give teams tools that match their responsibilities
